title: The ci suite repair is accepted
situation: CI had never run on dev; on PR 67 it failed 69 cli tests because test fixtures started bun, which only the operator's machine has; a canon test also relied on jq. The repair parses YAML in the test process and runs the drift-notice worker in its own directory; CI on a clean runner is green (run 38437577976), and a local run with bun, jq, omp and claude off the path is green.
decision: Accepted without assayers, as a one-package repair. Future work: make CI's lack of foreign programs explicit, so a test depending on one fails in CI rather than passing on the runner image.
consequences: Integrated into dev; PR 67 carries it to main.
